capabilities: Encrypt files on device before upload
disambiguation: Not a note-taking app; it syncs existing notes, attachments, and plugin settings across devices.
extras: Requires a registration invite from the operator, and there is no password reset. It is a hosted third-party service (not self-hosted); the operator can see account names, emails, remote vault names, and file metadata but not note contents or paths. Per-file limit is 40 MiB, and auto sync only handles Markdown.
problem: There is no built-in free way to sync only selected notes, attachments, and plugin settings across multiple devices.
summary: Sync service that syncs selected Obsidian notes, attachments, and community plugin settings across devices using a Blueee Notes account.
